invalid.title: This link is no longer valid
invalid.body: Ask your dispatcher for a new one.

offline_link.title: You are offline
offline_link.body: Connect to the internet, then open the link again.

safety.required_body: Read the site rules before you arrive. Without the briefing the gate cannot let you in.
safety.valid_visit: Safety briefing done for this visit

privacy.note: This page shows no personal data. Your name is stored only with the safety acknowledgement.

waiting.title: Please wait
waiting.body: You are checked in. We will call you to a dock on this page. Keep it open.

called.vibrated: Your phone vibrates when you are called. Keep this page open.

done.title: Loading done
done.body: Please drive to the gate. The gate records your departure.

closed.departed: You have left the site. Safe journey.
closed.no_show: This booking was marked as not arrived. Please call the site.
closed.turned_away: This visit was turned away at the gate. Please call the site.

gate_device: Briefing on the gate's device. Hand it back to the gate staff when you are done.
